# Project Context — Rafiq POS (رفيق)

Authoritative rules live in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) (Arabic, binding; CLAUDE.md holds only the GitNexus block). Detail: [README.md](../../README.md), [PROJECT_BACKLOG.md](../../PROJECT_BACKLOG.md), [UI_DESIGN_CATALOG.md](../../UI_DESIGN_CATALOG.md).

## Business
- Offline-first desktop POS and store management for Egyptian retail: supermarket/retail, clinical pharmacy (DDI, batches/FEFO, controlled drugs), cafe/restaurant (tables, KOT, recipes, delivery), e-payments/wallets (Vodafone Cash, InstaPay, Fawry, Aman), 11 store templates.
- Users: store owner (root/admin) and cashiers. UI is Arabic RTL. Target hardware: old Celeron PCs, Windows 7 SP1 to 11, 32/64-bit, 1024x768, no internet, sudden power cuts, RAM < 250MB.
- Licensing: Cloudflare Worker + D1 activation server (`license-server/`); signed license tokens verified offline (`desktop/Common/LicenseTokenVerifier.cs`).

## Stack
- Host: C# on .NET Framework 4.8, WinForms + WebView2 (NuGet 1.0.1518.46; Fixed Runtime 109 on Win7/8, Evergreen on Win10/11), x86 only. Language level C# 5 (enforced by `<LangVersion>5</LangVersion>` in `desktop/RafiqPOS.csproj`): no `=>` members, `nameof`, `$""`, `?.`, `out var`, pattern matching.
- DB: SQLite via `Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.Core` 9.0.10 + SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers 2.4.0 (native `sqlite3mc.dll`, x86, copied next to the exe by the csproj) behind our own compatibility layer `RafiqPOS.Data` (`desktop/Data/*.cs`: SQLiteConnection/Command/DataReader/Transaction/Parameter/Exception with the former System.Data.SQLite names and typing rules). **The database file is ENCRYPTED by default (ChaCha20, raw 256-bit key via `PRAGMA key` on every connection)**: `DatabaseKeyProvider` (runtime-derived key, never a literal, NEVER change it; S104 pins its SHA-256) installs `SQLiteConnection.ConnectionKeyHook`; per connection `Encryption=None` (plain file), `Encryption=Product` (force the program key) or `SetEncryptionKey`; `DatabaseFileAccess.OpenExisting(path, readOnly)` opens an arbitrary file by its header (use it for every backup/staging/package/legacy file). Legacy plain stores are converted at startup by `DatabaseEncryptionService` (crash-safe state machine with marker file, strict row-by-row verification, sealed `rafiq_pos.db.pre-encryption` kept 14 days AND 5 launches). Wrong key, other-build cipher or damaged header page = `ENCRYPTION_KEY_MISMATCH`: same user-initiated recovery flow as corruption (`IsCorrupt` + `IsKeyMismatch`, latest backup exposed, `database:restore`), zero automatic action. Factory reset also purges the sealed copy and marker files. Root-only IPC: `database:exportDecrypted`, `database:deletePreEncryptionCopy`, `database:retryEncryptionConversion`; admin: `database:getEncryptionStatus`. Full design, limits and support procedure: `docs/ENCRYPTED_DATABASE.md`. WAL with `synchronous=FULL` on every app connection (owner decision: no loss of committed sales on power cut; see AGENTS.md 2.A.3); production path `%ProgramData%\RafiqPOS\data\rafiq_pos.db`.
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript ~6.0, Vite 8 (target `chrome109`, `base './'`), Tailwind 3.4 (never v4), lucide-react, jsbarcode, xlsx (from cdn.sheetjs.com tarball), self-hosted Cairo / IBM Plex Sans Arabic fonts. Lint: oxlint. Tests: `node --test` with `--experimental-strip-types`. npm.
- License server: TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers/D1, wrangler, Node test runner.
- Installer: Inno Setup (`installer/RafiqPOS_Setup.iss`) + `.bat` build scripts; update packages via `scripts/build_update_package.ps1`.

## Architecture rules (summary of AGENTS.md; read it for full text)
- React UI -> typed IPC bridge (`BridgeMessage<T>` with `requestId`) -> `IpcDispatcher` -> Services -> Repositories -> SQLite. UI never touches the DB.
- Expired/invalid license gate (`IpcDispatcher.IsLicenseBlockedAction`) is deny-by-default: only read-verb actions, `auth:*`/`license:*`/`window:*` and the explicit `LICENSE_EXPIRED_ALLOWED_ACTIONS` set pass; any new mutating command is blocked automatically. Admin-tier accounts are never hard-locked at login (delay only, max 60 s); the owner recovery code is never blocked by it. `audit:resealChain` is owner/root only and audited.
- Money: integer piasters only (`long` in C#, `Money` in TS); never float/double; convert to EGP only at display. Quantities in milli-units.
- All sale/stock/ledger writes in one ACID transaction with rollback; no hard delete of invoices/stock movements (contra entries). UUID v4 string PKs plus display `invoice_number`.
- Returns: the refund follows the original tender (per-method caps in `ReturnService`); cash refunds need an open shift; a split refund (`Return.Refunds`) stores the first method on the master row and every further method as an item-less linked `returns` row (`idempotency_key = 'split:' + master id`) so every `refund_method = 'cash'` SQL keeps working. Cancelling a customer payment adds negative contra rows (`debt_allocations` type `payment`, `payments` `debt_settlement`), never deletes.
- Schema changes only via `MigrationRunner` with next incremental number; additive only (no DROP); backup before migration. Update packages must never contain `.db/.db-wal/.db-shm` or `data/`; no forced restart after update; SHA-256 check + auto rollback.
- UI: no `<select>` (use `CustomSelect`), no ad hoc hex colors (tailwind tokens: brand, paid, canvas, surface, line, ink, warn, danger), no emojis (lucide-react SVG only), no CDN/online assets, no horizontal scroll at 1024x768/1366x768. Printed paper previews stay white even in dark mode; Code 128 barcodes via `encodeInvoiceBarcode`; amounts in words via `tafqeetCurrency`.
- Every new feature needs RBAC keys in `SecurityService.cs` (ALL_PERMISSIONS, GetPermissionsForRole, SyncPermissionAliases), `UserManagerModal.tsx` PERMISSION_GROUPS, `App.tsx` nav gating, and in-screen gating.
- No unused code (`noUnusedLocals/Parameters`, oxlint). Errors isolated per subsystem with precise Arabic messages.
- Versioning SemVer; bump all in lockstep: `desktop/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs`, `desktop/app.manifest`, `frontend/package.json`, `installer/RafiqPOS_Setup.iss`, `Build_Installer.bat` installer name. Guarded by `frontend/test/app_update.test.js`.
- Work backlog strictly in order; never `git commit/push` unless explicitly asked.

## Environment quirks
- Mac compile check (no Windows needed): the C# 5 / net48 syntax and API check uses Roslyn from the .NET 8 SDK with a scratch SDK-style csproj OUTSIDE the repo (TargetFramework net48 + `Microsoft.NETFramework.ReferenceAssemblies` 1.0.3, `LangVersion 5`, `Compile Include` of `desktop/**/*.cs` minus bin/obj/packages/`RafiqPOS.Tests`/`RafiqPOS.Tests.Portable` (and minus `RafiqPOS.Tests` for the host), PackageReferences: WebView2 1.0.1518.46, Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.3, ClosedXML 0.95.4, DocumentFormat.OpenXml 2.7.2, ExcelNumberFormat 1.0.10, Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.Core 9.0.10, SQLitePCLRaw.core 3.0.2, SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle 2.4.0, NUnit 3.13.3); this catches missing members and C# 6 syntax (the Portable project compiles with the latest language version, so it does NOT replace this check). mono `xbuild` can also build the real `.csproj` files from a scratch copy with a hand-made `packages/` folder (it cannot evaluate `%(Filename)%(Extension)` in `LogicalName`, so drop that EmbeddedResource in the scratch copy). NUnit scenarios and self-tests RUN on macOS through `desktop/RafiqPOS.Tests.Portable` (net8.0, harness stubs for WinForms/WebView2/RSACng, `System.Drawing.Common` 5.0.3 + libgdiplus; it reads the source lists from the Windows csproj files, so there is no second list to maintain).
- Engine facts (measured): the old engine inside System.Data.SQLite 1.0.118 is SQLite 3.42.0 (TEMP_STORE=1, no DEFAULT_FOREIGN_KEYS, DQS on, STAT4, SOUNDEX, DBSTAT_VTAB, UPDATE_DELETE_LIMIT); the sqlite3mc 2.4.0 bundle is SQLite 3.53.4 (DEFAULT_FOREIGN_KEYS, DQS=0, SECURE_DELETE, TEMP_STORE=2, LIKE_DOESNT_MATCH_BLOBS, no STAT4/SOUNDEX/DBSTAT/UPDATE_DELETE_LIMIT; shipped code uses none of the missing features). The shim restores foreign_keys/DQS/secure_delete/temp_store defaults on every connection. Perf finding (pre-existing, same plan on 3.42.0 and 3.53), FIXED: `ProductRepository.GetByExactBarcode` drove the join from `idx_products_is_active` (about 7 ms at 50k products on macOS); the join now uses `+p.is_active = 1` (SQL in `BuildExactBarcodeSql`), 0.083-0.10 ms on an open connection, and S103 asserts the plan has no `SCAN p` and uses the primary key. Encryption adds about 0.2 ms per connection open and makes the per-sale benchmark about 53% slower on macOS (fresh connection per repository call; see `docs/ENCRYPTED_DATABASE.md` performance section and the pooling note there).
- Project root contains Arabic-named files and paths; always quote paths.
- Dev machine is macOS: the C# host, NUnit, WebView2 and installer cannot be built or run here; only frontend and license-server checks work.
- `npm run build` writes `frontend/dist` (gitignored) and first runs `sync:signatures`, which mirrors `desktop/Resources/signatures/*.png` into `frontend/src/assets/signatures/`.
- The GitNexus index referenced in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (`.gitnexus/`) is absent from this checkout and there is no git, so impact/detect_changes tooling is unavailable here; use grep/view and say so.
- `.env.example` exists; real `.env`, `.secrets/`, `*.pem` are gitignored. Never print values.

## User preferences
- Arabic is the primary language of docs and UI; respond to the owner in plain, short language.
- Strict adherence to AGENTS.md and backlog order; no auto-commit/push; always run lint + build and both Release/Debug MSBuild builds when on Windows before declaring done.
- **Encryption rules (P4):** `DatabaseKeyProvider` and every key-returning member are `internal` (tests use InternalsVisibleTo; S111 reflects over the public surface); never print or log the key or fragments; one global key (owner decision); keyed connections use `temp_store=MEMORY`; the shim command timeout derives from `BusyTimeout`; the native engine loads fail-closed (`DatabaseEngineMissingException`). Conversion = verified standard backup first (hard precondition), then `VACUUM INTO` an encrypted candidate (no plain intermediate), row-hash verification, sealed `.pre-encryption`, retried swap, `EncryptionSwapFatalException` is never swallowed and a missing live file next to leftovers never creates a new database. The conversion runs on a worker thread (`MainForm.PrepareEncryptionAtStartup`). `SweepPlainFiles` runs at every encrypted start; marker and `encryption.ok` are HMAC protected. Pinned SHA-256 of every NuGet DLL: `installer/prerequisites/NUGET_DLL_SHA256.txt` (verified by `installer/verify_nuget_dlls.ps1` in `Build_Installer.bat` and CI; no startup check). The installer locks `{app}` and requires Program Files. Details, limits and the downgrade rule: `docs/ENCRYPTED_DATABASE.md`.
